大春被青音揪了出来先是吓得半死，在看到陆昭菱包扎着的头时又来了勇气。
是了，二小姐只是一个乡野养大的，不受宠的，她怕什么？
她立即就挣脱开了，站直身子，气愤地瞪着青音。
“这里是陆家，你个外来的丫头可别太嚣张！”
但好歹还顾忌着青音可能真是晋王派来的，她不敢动手。
要是没有那层顾忌，她早已经一手挠过去了。
“我们的卖身契在小姐手里，只要小姐是陆家的人，那我们也是。”青音说。
她总得让陆家的人知道，她们以后是小姐的贴身丫鬟了。
大春闻言却是一喜，然后就变了脸色，伸手就狠狠地朝着青音的头发抓了过去，语气也发了狠。
她的手还没有碰到青音一根发丝，就被青音抓住了手腕，猛地一扭。
大春身形都随着手臂的扭动歪了过去。
她顺手就抄起了他们桌上的一把木饭勺，用饭勺背后对着大春的嘴打了下去。
大春只觉得一阵剧痛，瞬间嘴里就有了血腥味，舌头一顶，门牙都有点松动了。
“二小姐纵着恶婢打人了！呜，疼死了——”
他们一开始也是被陆昭菱说的在酱菜里吐口水这事震惊住，这事他们确实不知道！
但是大春那反应，他们却瞬间明白，这事她还真干了。
大家都在陆府一起干活这么多年，彼此间还是挺了解的，大春要是不心虚，刚才就不是那种表现。
还没有震惊完，现在又被陆昭菱主仆二人的凶悍惊呆了。
陆二小姐虽然头上有伤，虽然纤弱，但是站在那里气质清冷，没有半点小家子气，眼神更是平静，哪里像个在乡野被虐着长大的孩子？
不管她是谁派到陆家的，现在她就是听陆昭菱的话，打陆家下人是真不手软。
这说明什么？说明这丫鬟以前也是有底气的啊。
“谁让你这么做的？”青音带着怒火问大春。
那木饭勺这么打下来，疼得她现在脑子都嗡嗡的。
“窝没干泥不要冤枉窝”她说话都有点咬不清了。
被青音这么扭着手臂，她连挣扎都挣扎不开，又气又急又疼，眼泪哗哗的。
“是吗？”陆昭菱走近两步，一根手指头抵住她的额头，顶起她的脸。
大春对上了她的眼睛，只觉得那双耀如星子的眸子带着压迫感，让她不由得心头一颤。
陆昭菱手指有点气体钻进了她的额头，只是没人看得见。

Dachun was frightened to death when Qingyin pulled him out, but he gained courage again when he saw Lu Zhaoling's bandaged head.
Yes, the second young lady is just a country-raised and unpopular person. What is she afraid of?
She immediately broke away, stood up straight, and glared at Qingyin angrily.
"This is the Lu family, you foreign girl, don't be too arrogant!"
But she was still worried that Qingyin might really be sent by King Jin, so she didn't dare to take action.
If she didn't have that layer of scruples, she would have scratched it off with one hand.
"Our prostitution contract is in the hands of the young lady. As long as the young lady is from the Lu family, then so are we." Qingyin said.
She had to let the Lu family know that they would be the young lady's personal maids from now on.
Dachun was overjoyed when he heard this, and then his expression changed. He stretched out his hand and grabbed Qingyin's hair, and his tone became harsh.
Before her hand even touched a strand of Qingyin's hair, Qingyin grabbed her wrist and twisted it violently.
Dachun's body twisted as his arms twisted.
She picked up a wooden rice spoon on their table and hit Dachun in the mouth with the back of the rice spoon.
Dachun only felt a sharp pain, and instantly there was the smell of blood in his mouth. His front teeth were a little loose when his tongue pressed against him.
"The second young lady allowed the evil maid to beat someone! Oh, it hurts so much——"
They were also shocked at first by what Lu Zhaoling said about spitting in pickles, but they really didn't know about it!
But with Dachun's reaction, they instantly understood that she had really done this.
Everyone has worked together in the Lu Mansion for so many years, and they know each other quite well. If Dachun didn't feel guilty, he wouldn't have behaved like that just now.
The shock was not over yet, and now he was stunned by the ferocity of Lu Zhaoling's master and servant.
Although Miss Lu Er had injuries on her head and was delicate, she stood there with a cool temperament, not the slightest bit arrogant, and her eyes were calm. How could she look like a child who had been abused and grown up in the countryside?
No matter who sent her to the Lu family, now she just listens to Lu Zhaoling and is really merciless in beating the servants of the Lu family.
What does this mean? It shows that this maid had confidence before.
"Who asked you to do this?" Qingyin asked Dachun angrily.
The wooden rice spoon was knocked off like this, and it hurt so much that her head was buzzing.
"Don't accuse me of wrongdoing if the nest is dry." She could hardly speak clearly.
With Qingyin twisting her arm like this, she couldn't even struggle away. She was angry, anxious and in pain, and burst into tears.
"Really?" Lu Zhaoling took two steps closer, put a finger on her forehead, and raised her face.
Dachun met her eyes, and felt that those eyes that were as bright as stars had a sense of oppression, which made her heart tremble.
Lu Zhaoling's fingers dug into her forehead with some gas, but no one could see it.
She asked again, "Give you another chance, who ordered you to spit?"
